name: Tsuchidou Otome
source:
An elusive girl—hard to pin down—
yet strangely, if she’s not around, you really start to notice her absence.

She has sharp powers of observation and keen eyes that quickly see through secrets and hidden intentions.
But even when she notices something, she doesn’t press for answers…
Instead, she keeps a mysterious, perfectly balanced distance—never too close, never too far—an enigmatic girl with a subtle, almost magical presence.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Unknown
[b]Likes:[/b] Silence, nature
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Loud noises, disorder
[b]Hobby:[/b] Gardening (kind of like bonsai?)

[b]"Nii-ya!"[/b]
